title: FR-40's packet gets a carrier or an epitaph
body:
Outcome: either the arm-B packet is prepended to lane briefs on the lead's dispatch path and the FR-40 comparison is re-run through that carrier, or ADR 0002's status records that the result was measured under the worker and has no consumer.
Why: FR-40 is the only positive controlled result KRN has (ADR 0002:6-9: B-A +21.1 pp, B-S +11.3 pp, token ratio 1.086), and it was measured through `krn worker start` and `krn eval`, which D2 deletes. The first draft of this file said no measurement needed the cluster; that was wrong (section 8, mission 6).
Proof: for the carrier, the re-run reports the B-A gap on lanes next to +21.1 pp; for the epitaph, the ADR edit.
Limit: the carrier re-runs FR-40 on Claude lanes. D24 says "FR-40 runs Codex only" (0014:36) and ADR 0002:272 requires "a current task, an approved protocol, and a preregistration before results are observed", so the carrier needs a D24 amendment and a preregistered protocol before the run. The epitaph needs neither.
Scope: `src/brain`, the lead's dispatch brief, `evals/fr40`; or `docs/adr/0002`.
Order: Both removals touch frame files; merge them before A5. After it, the App opens the PR, the operator's credential pushes the workflow commit into it and, under A4, the operator approves.
Order: before D2.
Before the run: a D24 amendment ("FR-40 runs Codex only") and a preregistered protocol (ADR 0002:272) are merged. If the re-run shows no gap, write the epitaph.
Program: .krn/runs/krn-architecture-program/05-program.md section 4, slice D0.
Prereg merged in PR #544; next: the run per evals/fr40/preregistration-lanes.md.
